Charter Night fellowship
————————
Date : 3/11/2026
Venue : Cafe Moa , Hiranandani Gardens, Powai .
Total Attendees : 10 .
Members attended : 9 .
Rtns . Pres . Suparna , Dr. Vaishali,
Malabika , Chirag , Sree , Dibyendu, Pooja , Madhubanti, Chandrashekaran.
Past Member : Sudipta Mukherjee Mandal .

The 8 th Charter Night was celebrated at Cafe Moa , a fine dining place with great ambiance curated by Sudipta at her residence .
Being pre - Diwali period , everyone came gorgeously dressed in their Diwali finery.
An amazing evening spent over some innovative snacks & dinner delicacies , laughter, conversations and bonhomie.
Club ‘s fine memories over the years , appreciation of members contributions and some future events plans too were discussed .
An absolute memorable evening .
